about: External data for the validation suites. node validation/fetch.mjs downloads each file into validation/cache/<dataset>/ and checks its SHA-256. The files are not part of the repository or of the CytoWeave program; each keeps its own license.

gatingml.title: Gating-ML 2.0 compliance test suite (ISAC)
gatingml.description: Gating-ML 2.0 gate files with list-mode data and the expected membership of every event in every gate, as distributed in the Bioconductor package gatingMLData (J. Spidlen, N. Gopalakrishnan).
gatingml.license: Distributed by ISAC for testing Gating-ML compliance; the Bioconductor package is GPL. CytoWeave downloads it for testing and does not redistribute it.

flowkit.title: FlowKit 1.3.2 test data
flowkit.description: FlowJo 10 workspaces with their FCS files (an 8-color intracellular cytokine panel; synthetic diamond and line examples), compensation and spectral reference events, and FCS files from several instruments, as used by FlowKit's own tests.
flowkit.license: Part of FlowKit's repository (BSD-3-Clause); the provenance of the real data files is not documented there. CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

fcsparser.title: fcsparser test files
fcsparser.description: FCS files from several instruments (Cytek xP5, BD FACSCalibur, LSR II and Fortessa, Miltenyi MACSQuant in FCS 2.0, 3.0 and 3.1, Guava Muse with several data sets, CyFlow Cube 8) and deliberately malformed files. FACS_Diva/facs_diva_test.fcs is left out: it appears to be a clinical panel of unknown origin.
fcsparser.license: MIT (© 2018 Eugene Yurtsev). CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

cytoflow-instruments.title: cytoflow instrument test files (FCS and LMD from 13 instruments)
cytoflow-instruments.description: FCS 2.0 and 3.0 files and Beckman Coulter LMD files from many vendors, mostly bead runs, collected by Josef Spidlen for FCS reader developers and kept in cytoflow's tests: BD Accuri C6, Applied Biosystems Attune (first generation), Beckman Coulter CyAn, Gallios (LMD with a second data set), MoFlo Astrios (68 parameters) and MoFlo XDP, Cytek DxP10 and Northern Lights (the full file whose HEADER and TEXT fcsparser keeps as sample_header.fcs), Millipore Guava PCA (15 data sets chained by $NEXTDATA), Partec CyFlow (FCS 3.0) and PAS (FCS 2.0), Stratedigm S1400 (mixed 16- and 32-bit $PnB) and iCyt Eclipse. The System II, Cytomics FC500, FACSAria II, MACSQuant, Cytek xP5 and Guava Muse files of the same folder are left out (clinical panels, or instruments already covered).
cytoflow-instruments.source: https://github.com/cytoflow/cytoflow (cytoflow/tests/data/instruments, commit c31a6f5); the folder's README.txt credits Josef Spidlen; the files trace back to FlowRepository public experiment 4
cytoflow-instruments.license: Part of cytoflow's repository, GPL-2.0-or-later (https://github.com/cytoflow/cytoflow/blob/c31a6f5dfcecb471aad6386c97c30ac6dc39c5e8/LICENSE.txt). CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

files.path: Beckman Coulter - MoFlo Astrios - linear settings.fcs

flowio.title: FlowIO test files: Attune NxT, Accuri C6 Plus, Bio-Rad S3 and Stratedigm
flowio.description: FCS 3.0 and 3.1 files from FlowIO's test data: a Thermo Fisher Attune NxT plate well (HEK cells), a BD Accuri C6 Plus file, a Bio-Rad S3 sorter file with zero gains and a supplemental TEXT segment after DATA, and a Stratedigm S1400EXi file with mixed 16- and 32-bit parameters and anonymized keywords. Ki67-117 tube 1.LMD of the same folder is left out: its file name and keywords point to a clinical sample.
flowio.license: Part of FlowIO's repository, BSD-3-Clause (https://github.com/whitews/FlowIO/blob/83d28a22d42235c10d17afb017250ee208afed95/LICENSE); the provenance of the files is not documented there. CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

flowcal.title: FlowCal test files: FACSCanto II FCS 2.0 export and Cytek xP3+ 24-bit data
flowcal.description: Two of FlowCal's test files: a BD FACSCanto II file written as FCS 2.0 by FACSDiva (16-bit integers, log amplification) and a Cytek xP3+ file written by FlowJo Collector's Edition with 24-bit big-endian integers ($PnB 24).
flowcal.license: Part of FlowCal's repository, MIT (https://github.com/taborlab/FlowCal/blob/0212f417a53b2fc76658d83b751b892f2d05f175/license.txt). CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

flowcal-mef.title: FlowCal's MEF example: 8-peak calibration beads and cell samples
flowcal-mef.description: FlowCal's example data (Castillo-Hair et al. 2016): 8-peak calibration beads and E. coli samples expressing sfGFP under a DAPG-inducible promoter, on a Cytek xP3+ (FL1, log amplification over 4 decades): three bead samples (two days, one at another gain) with their MEFL values, and twelve cell samples.
flowcal-mef.license: Part of FlowCal's repository, MIT (https://github.com/taborlab/FlowCal/blob/0212f417a53b2fc76658d83b751b892f2d05f175/license.txt). CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

zenodo-instruments.title: Instrument variety from Zenodo: one or two files from each of 23 cytometers
zenodo-instruments.description: Small FCS files from CC BY 4.0 Zenodo records, chosen for instrument and writer variety: Beckman Coulter CytoFLEX (big-endian), CytoFLEX S (little-endian) and DxFLEX (one complete file and one whose DATA segment is truncated); Agilent NovoCyte (NovoExpress, $UNICODE) and NovoCyte Penteon; Cytek Aurora raw 5-laser files (71 and 74 parameters) and an Aurora Evo bead file (SpectroFlo 4, UTF-8 in CREATOR); Sony SA3800, MA900 and SH800; BD FACSDiscover S8 (FCS 3.2, 440 parameters, mixed $PnDATATYPE, a 720 kB TEXT segment), FACSymphony A5 SE, FACSLyric and FACSVerse (FACSuite), FACSMelody (FACSChorus) and Influx; Thermo Fisher Bigfoot; Cytek/Luminex CellStream (84 parameters); Amnis ImageStream (IDEAS export); Guava easyCyte (InCyte, FCS 2.0 big-endian); Bio-Rad ZE5 ($CYT YETI, Propel Labs' name for it); a raw CyTOF/Helios file; BeamCyte (TEXT in GBK).
zenodo-instruments.source: Zenodo records https://zenodo.org/records/5174952, https://zenodo.org/records/7659210, https://zenodo.org/records/7971252, https://zenodo.org/records/10639508, https://zenodo.org/records/13773748, https://zenodo.org/records/14246044, https://zenodo.org/records/14538019, https://zenodo.org/records/14791966, https://zenodo.org/records/14893440, https://zenodo.org/records/14989800, https://zenodo.org/records/15350040, https://zenodo.org/records/15726118, https://zenodo.org/records/17098564, https://zenodo.org/records/17222100, https://zenodo.org/records/17457137, https://zenodo.org/records/18439538, https://zenodo.org/records/18985327, https://zenodo.org/records/19221995, https://zenodo.org/records/20157668, https://zenodo.org/records/20559117, https://zenodo.org/records/21643327, https://zenodo.org/records/21824329, https://zenodo.org/records/22029676, https://zenodo.org/records/22937779
zenodo-instruments.license: CC BY 4.0, as each Zenodo record states (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

zenodo-nanofcm.title: NanoFCM Flow NanoAnalyzer file (Zenodo 14270626)
zenodo-nanofcm.description: An FCS 3.0 file from a NanoFCM Flow NanoAnalyzer (extracellular vesicles): form-feed delimiter, empty keyword values ($PROJ, $OP) written as two adjacent delimiters, big-endian floats, $BEGINSTEXT pointing at the primary TEXT.
zenodo-nanofcm.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). CytoWeave downloads the file for testing and does not redistribute it.

rosettax.title: RosettaX sample files: Apogee A60-Micro and Cytek Northern Lights rainbow beads
rosettax.description: Rainbow calibration bead runs on an Apogee A60-Micro (FCS 3.0, 32-bit integers, a supplemental TEXT segment holding Apogee's own settings block rather than keyword/value pairs) and on a Cytek Northern Lights (FCS 3.1, SpectroFlo 3.0.3; $BEGINSTEXT 0 with a nonzero $ENDSTEXT), from RosettaX's sample files.
rosettax.license: Part of RosettaX's repository, AGPL-3.0-or-later (https://github.com/MartinPdeS/RosettaX/blob/24b9e8a9a698c103084d7dc019815cf358f056f5/LICENSE). CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

rpackages.title: Example data of the R packages PeacoQC, FlowSOM and CytoNorm
rpackages.description: PeacoQC's 111.fcs; FlowSOM's 68983.fcs with the FlowJo workspace gated on it; CytoNorm's six control files (three batches, the same two volunteers in each).
rpackages.license: Distributed with GPL-licensed R packages. CytoWeave downloads them for testing and does not redistribute them.

zenodo-skull.title: Skull bone marrow chimera: compensation controls and two samples (Zenodo 22808501)
zenodo-skull.description: Single-stain compensation controls of a BD LSRFortessa panel and two bone-marrow samples, from "Example of skull bone marrow chimera using congenic mice".
zenodo-skull.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

als-ics.title: ALS C9orf72 intracellular cytokine staining, screens 3 and 4 (Zenodo 16754591, 16754609)
als-ics.description: Four FlowJo 10 workspaces (ALS patients and healthy controls, two screens) of 12 LSRFortessa wells each: four donors, each in a negative, a peptide-stimulated and a PMA/ionomycin well, with the expert's gates adjusted per donor. From "Autoimmune response to C9orf72 protein in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis" (Michaelis, Johansson, Sulzer, Sette). The FCS files are stored under the names the workspaces use.
als-ics.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

flowqbdata.title: flowQB test data: an LSR II's LED pulser series and multi-level beads
flowqbdata.description: From the Bioconductor package flowQBData (Spidlen, El Khettabi, Moore, Parks, Brinkman), measured at Stanford's Shared FACS Facility: 19 files of an LED pulser at increasing intensities, a Spherotech 8-peak (Sph8) and a Thermo Fisher 6-peak (TF6) bead file, all on one BD LSR II.
flowqbdata.license: Artistic License 2.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

axe-core.title: axe-core 4.13.0 (Deque Systems)
axe-core.description: The accessibility rule engine run in every documentation scene by node docs/capture/capture.mjs --audit (WCAG 2.1 A and AA rules).
axe-core.source: https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core (npm package axe-core, served by jsDelivr)
axe-core.license: MPL-2.0. CytoWeave downloads it for testing and does not ship or redistribute it.

diva.title: FACSDiva experiment export (flowWorkspaceData)
diva.description: A BD FACSDiva 6.1.3 experiment exported as XML (PE_2: compensation controls and four sample tubes of a FACSCanto II 8-color panel, with Diva's count of every population) and the FCS file of one tube, as used by CytoML's tests of its Diva reader.
diva.license: flowWorkspaceData is GPL-2 (Greg Finak). CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

chorus-a8.title: FACSDiscover A8 recording (Zenodo 15726118), HEADER and TEXT only
chorus-a8.description: The HEADER and TEXT segments (the first 1,012,655 bytes) of HD PBMC.fcs, a BD FACSDiscover A8 recording made with FACSChorus 6.1.0, whose BDCHORUSDATARECORD keyword holds the recording's gates (scatter, singlets, time and image-feature gates, and Chorus's automatic saturation gates) as FACSChorus defined them.
chorus-a8.source: https://zenodo.org/records/15726118 (Imaging cytometry data supporting Cleanet manuscript)
chorus-a8.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the bytes for testing and does not redistribute them.

spectroflo.title: Cytek Aurora experiment with reference controls (AutoSpectral example, Mendeley ch5dnspd79 v1)
spectroflo.description: From a SpectroFlo experiment on a 5-laser Cytek Aurora (mouse, 9 colors): the experiment file (.Expt), which holds the reference spectra SpectroFlo computed from its cell controls, and the raw files of four of those controls (BUV395, BV421, APC, eFluor 780) and of the unstained cell control. Each file is fetched by byte range from the dataset's 2.1 GB ZIP archive and inflated.
spectroflo.source: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/ch5dnspd79/1 (Burton O, Dooley J, Liston A. AutoSpectral: Full Workflow Example. Mendeley Data, v1, 2025. doi:10.17632/ch5dnspd79.1)
spectroflo.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

autospectral.title: AutoSpectral example: bead and cell controls of six dyes, and unstained spleen unfixed and fixed (Mendeley ch5dnspd79 v1)
autospectral.description: From the same 5-laser Cytek Aurora experiment as the spectroflo data set (mouse): the bead controls of the six dyes that also have cell controls (BUV395, BUV805, BV421, PE, PE-Cy7, APC), the three cell controls the spectroflo set lacks (CD11b BUV805, Siglec F PE, F4/80 PE-Cy7), and unstained spleen unfixed and fixed in 4% PFA. Each file is fetched by byte range from the dataset's 2.1 GB ZIP archive and inflated.
autospectral.source: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/ch5dnspd79/1 (Burton O, Dooley J, Liston A. AutoSpectral: Full Workflow Example. Mendeley Data, v1, 2025. doi:10.17632/ch5dnspd79.1)
autospectral.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

zenodo-skull-fmo.title: Skull bone marrow chimera: FMO controls and the unstained control (Zenodo 22808501)
zenodo-skull-fmo.description: The FMO controls, live/dead control and unstained control of the BD LSRFortessa panel in "Example of skull bone marrow chimera using congenic mice"; with the compensation controls and samples of zenodo-skull, they check virtual FMOs against real ones.
zenodo-skull-fmo.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.

omip-tdln.title: Mouse tumor-draining lymph node, 25-color spectral panel: reference controls, a full stain and FMO controls (Zenodo 20644656)
omip-tdln.description: From "Flow cytometry dataset for OMIP publication_Petti" (Cytek Aurora, 5 lasers): the 25 bead reference controls, the negative beads, the unstained and viability (FVS440UV) cell references, a fully stained lymph node (TDLN 4) and six pooled FMO controls (CD4, CD8, CD11b, Ly6C, MHCII, CX3CR1). Each is one entry of the record's 7.2 GB ZIP archive, read by byte range; of the large files only the first 100,000 events are kept (validation/fcs-subset.mjs), the rest of the archive is not downloaded.
omip-tdln.license: CC BY 4.0. CytoWeave downloads the files for testing and does not redistribute them.
